description: Workday customer tax ID type values for the AR customer template. Snapshot of the CCS `FA E2E Customers V1.xlsm` country-specific `*_Tax_Type` named ranges, keyed by ISO country code so `Tax ID Type` can cascade from `Tax ID Country Code`. Where the workbook exposes no country-specific range, the migration SQL fallback is used (`TIN`, or the mapped default where one exists).
provenance: Transcribed 2026-07-22 from `/Users/Rakesh.Patel/Documents/__data/excel/threeplus/CCS/FA E2E Customers V1.xlsm` tax-type named ranges (for example `United_Kingdom_Tax_Type`, `France_Tax_Type`). Fallback rows for countries with no workbook range follow `elt_ingest_excel/config/transform/sql/finance/customer/workday_customer_tax.sql` and `elt_ingest_excel/config/data/ref_country_tax_id_type_mapping.json`. Snapshot only, not a live link. reference_id added 2026-10-12 (Master Customers load: Tax ID Type* takes the Workday Tax_ID_Type reference ID) by joining each row on accent- and case-folded country name plus tax ID type display value to the Customer EIB tenant table 'Tenant Default Named Ranges'!AB/AC/AD (Tax_ID_Types / Tax_ID_Types Ref ID / Tax Country; 799 rows) of `/Users/Rakesh.Patel/Documents/__data/excel/threeplus/CCS/FA E2E Customers V1.xlsm` (alias Czechia -> Czech Republic). reference_source = customer_tenant for 524 rows; 1 row resolved from the supplier tenant lookup ref_supplier_country_tax_id_type.json (same country code and display value; reference_source = supplier_tenant); 9 rows have NO tenant reference ID and are left EMPTY (reference_source = none, no guessed IDs): the ref_country TIN fallbacks for AX, BL, MF, PM, plus FM RUT, KR VAT Registration Number / VAT Number (ALV) / Business ID and MK NIF. The transform rejects a customer whose typed tax ID type has an empty reference_id. country_tax_key ('<ISO2>|<tax_id_type>') is the runtime lookup key (key_column), because tax_id_type alone repeats across countries.
